title: Preserve Canvas Position and Zoom Level

test_cases.title: 289188-AC1: Preserve Canvas Position and Zoom Level / Save & Restore / Canvas Position Is Saved and Restored on Reopen

steps.action: Pre-req: The ENV SiteDraft App is installed
Launch the ENV SiteDraft application.
steps.expected: Model space(Gray) and Canvas(white) space should be displayed

steps.action: From the Home screen, select 'New File', press 'Create', select a save location, and press 'Save'.
steps.expected: A new blank drawing opens and is displayed on the Canvas.

steps.action: Pan the canvas to a distinct area away from the default view and note the position.
steps.expected: The canvas scrolls to the new area and displays it.

steps.action: Perform a Save action on the drawing.
steps.expected: The drawing is saved successfully with the current canvas position.

steps.action: Close the drawing.
steps.expected: The drawing closes.

steps.action: Reopen the saved drawing.
steps.expected: The canvas automatically opens at the last saved position (the same area noted in step 4), with no manual navigation required.

steps.action: Close the ENV SiteDraft App

test_cases.objective: Verify that the current canvas position is saved when the user performs a Save action, and that reopening the drawing automatically restores the last saved position without manual navigation.

test_cases.title: 289188-005: Preserve Canvas Position and Zoom Level / Save & Restore / Zoom Level Is Saved and Restored on Reopen

steps.action: Pre-req: The ENV SiteDraft App is installed
Launch the ENV SiteDraft application.
steps.expected: Model space(Gray) and Canvas(white) space should be displayed

steps.action: From the Home screen, select 'New File', press 'Create', select a save location, and press 'Save'.
steps.expected: A new blank drawing opens and is displayed on the Canvas.

steps.action: Change the zoom level to a specific, non-default value (for example, zoom in to 200%) and note the value.
steps.expected: The canvas is displayed at the selected zoom level.

steps.action: Perform a Save action on the drawing.
steps.expected: The drawing is saved successfully with the current zoom level.

steps.action: Close the drawing.
steps.expected: The drawing closes.

steps.action: Reopen the saved drawing.
steps.expected: The canvas automatically opens using the last saved zoom level (the value noted in step 4), with no manual zoom adjustment required.

steps.action: Close the ENV SiteDraft App

test_cases.objective: Verify that the current zoom level is saved when the user performs a Save action, and that reopening the drawing automatically restores the last saved zoom level without manual adjustment.

test_cases.title: 289188-010: Preserve Canvas Position and Zoom Level / Compatibility / Legacy Drawing Opens Without Errors

steps.action: Pre-req: The ENV SiteDraft App is installed
Pre-req: A drawing file created before the Preserve Canvas Position and Zoom Level enhancement is available
Launch the ENV SiteDraft application.
steps.expected: Model space(Gray) and Canvas(white) space should be displayed

steps.action: Open the legacy drawing file created before this enhancement.
steps.expected: The drawing opens successfully without any errors or warnings.

steps.action: Close the ENV SiteDraft App

test_cases.objective: Verify that existing drawing files created before this enhancement continue to open successfully without errors.

test_cases.title: 289188-015: Preserve Canvas Position and Zoom Level / Default Behavior / Drawing Without Saved View Uses Default Opening

steps.action: Pre-req: The ENV SiteDraft App is installed
Pre-req: A drawing file that does not contain saved position and zoom information is available
Launch the ENV SiteDraft application.
steps.expected: Model space(Gray) and Canvas(white) space should be displayed

steps.action: Open the drawing that does not contain saved position and zoom information.
steps.expected: The drawing opens using the application's default opening behavior (default position and default zoom level).

steps.action: Close the ENV SiteDraft App

test_cases.objective: Verify that drawings which do not contain saved position and zoom information open using the application's default opening behavior.

test_cases.title: 289188-020: Preserve Canvas Position and Zoom Level / Cross-Platform / Position and Zoom Restored Consistently Across Platforms

steps.action: Pre-req: The ENV SiteDraft App is installed on the supported platform under test (Windows 11 / iPad / Android Tablet)
Launch the ENV SiteDraft application.
steps.expected: Model space(Gray) and Canvas(white) space should be displayed

steps.action: From the Home screen, select 'New File', press 'Create', select a save location, and press 'Save'.
steps.expected: A new blank drawing opens and is displayed on the Canvas.

steps.action: Pan the canvas to a distinct area and set a specific zoom level, then note both values.
steps.expected: The canvas displays the new position at the selected zoom level.

steps.action: Perform a Save action on the drawing.
steps.expected: The drawing is saved successfully with the current position and zoom level.

steps.action: Close and reopen the saved drawing.
steps.expected: The canvas opens at the last saved position and zoom level.

steps.action: Repeat steps 2-6 on each supported platform (Windows 11, iPad, Android Tablet).
steps.expected: The save and restore behavior is consistent on every supported platform.

steps.action: Close the ENV SiteDraft App

test_cases.objective: Verify that the save-and-restore of canvas position and zoom level works consistently across all supported platforms (Windows 11, iPad, Android Tablet).
